pages.text: {{hero}} loved helping Grandma in her garden. Every morning, {{hero}} watered the tomatoes and counted the bees. One sunny Saturday, {{hero}} found a tiny golden seed hiding under a leaf.
{{hero}} wanted to plant the seed and see what it would become. {{hero}} picked the perfect spot near the fence, dug a little hole, and patted the soil down gently. Now {{hero}} just had to wait.
Days went by, but nothing grew. {{hero}} checked every morning and every evening. Still just dirt! {{hero}} started to wonder if the seed was too small, or if it did not like its new home.
Grandma smiled and said, "Some seeds need a little more water and a lot more patience." So {{hero}} gave it a drink every day. Then one morning, a bright green sprout poked up!
That night, {{hero}} snuggled into bed, tired and happy. Outside, the sprout swayed in the moonlight. But when {{hero}} peeked out the window, the little plant was glowing. What kind of seed was it?
